d:
Saudi vs Iran dushmani ki puri kahani: ek hi kuran, ek hi kibla, phir bhi Mecca men 1987 ka khun, Syria, Yemen, Libya ki laraiyan, Israel aur America ka rol, aur 2023 men China ke bich men parne par hath milana. kya ye shiya sunni ki jang hai ya takat ki? ham kisi ek paksh ki taraph nahin hain, donon taraph ki bat aur jankaron ki ray rakhi hai.
Shubhankar Mishra: A journalist who navigates the spectrum from Aajtak to Zee News, now independently exploring social media journalism, with a knack for engaging political figures in insightful podcasts.
